```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Step 1: Load packages and data
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(shiny)

df <- read_csv("data/index_scores_v3_2026.csv") |>
  rename(
    composite     = `Composite Score`,
    school_name   = Name,
    state         = State,
    city          = City,
    park_access   = `Park access`,
    broadband     = `Access to broadband internet`,
    healthcare    = `Access to healthcare`,
    violent_crime = `Violent crime rate`,
    snap          = `SNAP recipients`,
    housing_aff   = `Housing affordability`,
    poverty       = Poverty
  )

county_pop <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B01003_001",
  year      = 2023
) |>
  rename(fips = GEOID, population = estimate) |>
  select(fips, population)

df <- df |>
  mutate(
    fips = str_pad(`FIPS County Code`, width = 5, pad = "0"),
    across(c(broadband, healthcare, park_access, violent_crime, snap,
             composite, poverty, housing_aff),
           ~ as.numeric(ifelse(. == "N/A", NA, .)))
  ) |>
  left_join(county_pop, by = "fips")

my_school <- df |>
  filter(state == "NC", city == "Fayetteville") |>
  slice(1)

cat("County population:", format(my_school$population, big.mark=","), "\n")
```

```{r}
# ── eligibility check ─────────────────────────
eligible <- list(
  park_access   = as.numeric(my_school$park_access)   > 4,   # above target
  broadband     = as.numeric(my_school$broadband)     > 9,   # above national
  healthcare    = as.numeric(my_school$healthcare)    > 2,   # above national 
  violent_crime = as.numeric(my_school$violent_crime) > 8,   # above national 
  snap          = as.numeric(my_school$poverty)       > 30 &
                  as.numeric(my_school$snap)          > 31    # above PCT_TARGET
)

cat("=== ELIGIBILITY CHECK ===\n")
for (nm in names(eligible)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-20s %s\n", nm, ifelse(eligible[[nm]], "✓ eligible", "✗ skip")))
}

# ── population multiplier ─────────────────────
nat_median_pop <- 85000   # median county population that has high schools
pop_multiplier <- sqrt(as.numeric(my_school$population) / nat_median_pop)
pop_multiplier <- max(0.5, min(pop_multiplier, 3.0))

# ── RPP adjustment (BEA 2022) ─────────────────
rpp_table <- c(
  AL=87.5, AK=104.9, AZ=96.5, AR=86.0, CA=113.4, CO=101.9, CT=108.1,
  DE=101.3, FL=100.7, GA=91.9, HI=111.0, ID=93.4, IL=96.3, IN=89.5,
  IA=90.5, KS=89.8, KY=87.8, LA=91.0, ME=96.1, MD=108.3, MA=111.1,
  MI=91.7, MN=98.0, MS=83.3, MO=89.8, MT=94.0, NE=91.0, NV=98.3,
  NH=106.0, NJ=109.0, NM=91.5, NY=108.1, NC=93.8, ND=94.3, OH=90.3,
  OK=87.5, OR=101.5, PA=96.7, RI=106.2, SC=91.7, SD=91.4, TN=89.4,
  TX=95.0, UT=96.7, VT=105.8, VA=100.8, WA=105.3, WV=83.8, WI=94.3,
  WY=95.7, DC=121.2, PR=100.0
)
rpp_factor    <- rpp_table[my_school$state] / 100
pop_multiplier <- pop_multiplier * rpp_factor   # combined multiplier
cat(sprintf("\nCombined multiplier: %.4fx (pop_factor=%.4f, RPP=%.1f)\n",
            pop_multiplier, pop_multiplier / rpp_factor, rpp_table[my_school$state]))

# ── adjusted costs ────────────────────────────
base_costs <- list(
  park_access = 400000, broadband = 120000,
  healthcare  = 320000, violent_crime = 90000, snap = 700000
)
adj_costs <- lapply(base_costs, function(x) x * pop_multiplier)

# ── optimizer ─────────────────────────────────
target_reduction <- 5
max_contribution <- target_reduction * 0.40

current <- list(
  park_access   = as.numeric(my_school$park_access),
  broadband     = as.numeric(my_school$broadband),
  healthcare    = as.numeric(my_school$healthcare),
  violent_crime = as.numeric(my_school$violent_crime),
  snap          = as.numeric(my_school$snap)
)
current   <- lapply(current, function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 50, x))

# PCT_TARGETS: 10th percentile of stress score = 90th pct performance nationally
pct_targets <- list(park_access=4, broadband=9, healthcare=2, violent_crime=8, snap=31)

max_improve <- list(
  park_access   = max(0, current$park_access   - pct_targets$park_access),
  broadband     = max(0, current$broadband     - pct_targets$broadband),
  healthcare    = max(0, current$healthcare    - pct_targets$healthcare),
  violent_crime = max(0, current$violent_crime - pct_targets$violent_crime),
  snap          = max(0, current$snap          - pct_targets$snap)
)

K <- 100 / (63 - 9)   # ODIS rescaling factor
coefs <- list(
  park_access   = (1/15) * K,   # 1/5 domain * 1/3 indicator
  broadband     = 0.05   * K,   # 1/5 domain * 1/4 indicator
  healthcare    = 0.04   * K,   # 1/5 domain * 1/5 indicator
  violent_crime = 0.10   * K,   # 1/5 domain * 1/2 indicator
  snap          = 0.04   * K    # 1/5 domain * 1/5 indicator
)

efficiency <- data.frame(
  intervention = names(coefs),
  coef         = unlist(coefs),
  cost_per_pt  = unlist(adj_costs),
  max_improve  = unlist(max_improve)
) |>
  mutate(
    eligible = c(
      eligible$park_access,
      eligible$broadband,
      eligible$healthcare,
      eligible$violent_crime,
      eligible$snap
    ),
    efficiency       = coef / cost_per_pt,
    max_stress_reduc = coef * max_improve
  ) |>
  filter(eligible == TRUE) |>
  arrange(desc(efficiency))

remaining  <- target_reduction
total_cost <- 0
plan       <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(efficiency)) {
  if (remaining <= 0) break
  row        <- efficiency[i, ]
  use_reduc  <- min(remaining, row$max_stress_reduc, max_contribution)
  pts_needed <- use_reduc / row$coef
  cost       <- pts_needed * row$cost_per_pt

  plan <- rbind(plan, data.frame(
    intervention     = row$intervention,
    improve_by       = round(pts_needed, 1),
    stress_reduction = round(use_reduc, 2),
    cost             = round(cost)
  ))

  remaining  <- remaining - use_reduc
  total_cost <- total_cost + cost
}

# ── results ───────────────────────────────────
cat("\n=== OPTIMAL PLAN: reduce stress by", target_reduction, "points ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Costs adjusted for Cumberland County (%.2fx multiplier)\n\n", pop_multiplier))
for (i in 1:nrow(plan)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-20s +%4.1f pts  →  -%.2f stress  |  $%s\n",
    plan$intervention[i],
    plan$improve_by[i],
    plan$stress_reduction[i],
    format(plan$cost[i], big.mark=",")))
}
cat(sprintf("\n  TOTAL COST:    $%s\n", format(round(total_cost), big.mark=",")))
cat(sprintf("  Original score: %.1f  →  New score: %.1f\n",
    my_school$composite, my_school$composite - target_reduction))
```


```{r}
shinyApp(
  ui = fluidPage(
    h3("Can You Fix It? School Stress Intervention Calculator"),

    fluidRow(
      column(6,
        selectInput("state_sel", "Select State:",
                    choices  = sort(unique(df$state)),
                    selected = "NC")
      ),
      column(6,
        selectInput("school_sel", "Select School:", choices = NULL)
      )
    ),

    hr(),
    h4("Current School Profile"),
    tableOutput("profile_table"),

    hr(),
    h4("Recommended Optimal Plan"),
    p("This is the cheapest combination of interventions to reduce stress by your target."),
    fluidRow(
      column(4,
        numericInput("target", "Target stress reduction (points):",
                     value = 5, min = 1, max = 20, step = 1)
      )
    ),
    tableOutput("optimizer_table"),
    verbatimTextOutput("optimizer_summary"),

    hr(),
    uiOutput("explanation_text"),
    br(),

    h4("Customize Your Own Plan"),
    p("Type a value or use the +/- arrows. Maximum is capped at what is realistically achievable."),

    fluidRow(
      column(3,
        numericInput("s_broadband",  "Broadband improvement (pts)",     value=0, min=0, step=1),
        textOutput("cap_broadband"),
        br(),
        numericInput("s_healthcare", "Healthcare improvement (pts)",    value=0, min=0, step=1),
        textOutput("cap_healthcare"),
        br(),
        numericInput("s_crime",      "Crime reduction (pts)",           value=0, min=0, step=1),
        textOutput("cap_crime"),
        br(),
        numericInput("s_snap",       "SNAP outreach improvement (pts)", value=0, min=0, step=1),
        textOutput("cap_snap"),
        br(),
        numericInput("s_park",       "Park access improvement (pts)",   value=0, min=0, step=1),
        textOutput("cap_park")
      ),
      column(9,
        h5("Cost & Impact Breakdown"),
        tableOutput("manual_table"),
        br(),
        verbatimTextOutput("manual_summary")
      )
    )
  ),

  server = function(input, output, session) {

    # Dynamic school dropdown
    observeEvent(input$state_sel, {
      schools_in_state <- df |>
        filter(state == input$state_sel) |>
        pull(school_name) |>
        sort() |>
        unique()
      updateSelectInput(session, "school_sel", choices = schools_in_state)
    })

    # Selected school reactive
    selected_school <- reactive({
      req(input$school_sel)
      df |>
        filter(state == input$state_sel, school_name == input$school_sel) |>
        slice(1)
    })

    # Caps and multiplier reactive
    school_meta <- reactive({
      s  <- selected_school()
      rpp_table <- c(
        AL=87.5, AK=104.9, AZ=96.5, AR=86.0, CA=113.4, CO=101.9, CT=108.1,
        DE=101.3, FL=100.7, GA=91.9, HI=111.0, ID=93.4, IL=96.3, IN=89.5,
        IA=90.5, KS=89.8, KY=87.8, LA=91.0, ME=96.1, MD=108.3, MA=111.1,
        MI=91.7, MN=98.0, MS=83.3, MO=89.8, MT=94.0, NE=91.0, NV=98.3,
        NH=106.0, NJ=109.0, NM=91.5, NY=108.1, NC=93.8, ND=94.3, OH=90.3,
        OK=87.5, OR=101.5, PA=96.7, RI=106.2, SC=91.7, SD=91.4, TN=89.4,
        TX=95.0, UT=96.7, VT=105.8, VA=100.8, WA=105.3, WV=83.8, WI=94.3,
        WY=95.7, DC=121.2, PR=100.0
      )
      rpp <- rpp_table[s$state] / 100
      pm  <- sqrt(as.numeric(s$population) / 85000)
      pm  <- max(0.5, min(pm, 3.0)) * rpp
      list(
        pop_multiplier = pm,
        caps = list(
          broadband  = max(0, round(as.numeric(s$broadband)     -  9)),
          healthcare = max(0, round(as.numeric(s$healthcare)    -  2)),
          crime      = max(0, round(as.numeric(s$violent_crime) -  8)),
          snap       = max(0, round(as.numeric(s$snap)          - 31)),
          park       = max(0, round(as.numeric(s$park_access)   -  4))
        ),
        eligible = list(
          broadband  = !is.na(s$broadband)     && as.numeric(s$broadband)     >  9,
          healthcare = !is.na(s$healthcare)    && as.numeric(s$healthcare)    >  2,
          crime      = !is.na(s$violent_crime) && as.numeric(s$violent_crime) >  8,
          snap       = !is.na(s$poverty)       && as.numeric(s$poverty)       > 30 &&
                       !is.na(s$snap)          && as.numeric(s$snap)          > 31,
          park       = !is.na(s$park_access)   && as.numeric(s$park_access)   >  4
        )
      )
    })

    # Reset inputs when school changes
    observeEvent(school_meta(), {
      caps <- school_meta()$caps
      updateNumericInput(session, "s_broadband",  max = caps$broadband,  value = 0)
      updateNumericInput(session, "s_healthcare", max = caps$healthcare, value = 0)
      updateNumericInput(session, "s_crime",      max = caps$crime,      value = 0)
      updateNumericInput(session, "s_snap",       max = caps$snap,       value = 0)
      updateNumericInput(session, "s_park",       max = caps$park,       value = 0)
    })

    # Profile table
    output$profile_table <- renderTable({
      s <- selected_school()
      data.frame(
        Indicator = c("Composite Stress", "Park Access", "Broadband",
                      "Healthcare", "Violent Crime", "SNAP Recipients", "Poverty"),
        Current.Value = c(
          round(as.numeric(s$composite), 1),
          round(as.numeric(s$park_access), 1),
          round(as.numeric(s$broadband), 1),
          round(as.numeric(s$healthcare), 1),
          round(as.numeric(s$violent_crime), 1),
          round(as.numeric(s$snap), 1),
          round(as.numeric(s$poverty), 1)
        ),
        National.Percentile = c(
          NA,
          round(mean(df$park_access   <= as.numeric(s$park_access),   na.rm=TRUE)*100),
          round(mean(df$broadband     <= as.numeric(s$broadband),     na.rm=TRUE)*100),
          round(mean(df$healthcare    <= as.numeric(s$healthcare),    na.rm=TRUE)*100),
          round(mean(df$violent_crime <= as.numeric(s$violent_crime), na.rm=TRUE)*100),
          round(mean(df$snap          <= as.numeric(s$snap),          na.rm=TRUE)*100),
          round(mean(df$poverty       <= as.numeric(s$poverty),       na.rm=TRUE)*100)
        )
      )
    })

    # Optimizer
    optimizer_plan <- reactive({
      s    <- selected_school()
      meta <- school_meta()
      pm   <- meta$pop_multiplier
      elig <- meta$eligible
      caps <- meta$caps


      K_shiny   <- 100 / (63 - 9)
      coefs     <- c(broadband  = 0.05   * K_shiny,
                     healthcare = 0.04   * K_shiny,
                     crime      = 0.10   * K_shiny,
                     snap       = 0.04   * K_shiny,
                     park       = (1/15) * K_shiny)
      base_cost <- c(broadband=120000, healthcare=320000,
                     crime=90000,      snap=700000, park=400000)
      max_imp   <- c(broadband  = caps$broadband,
                     healthcare = caps$healthcare,
                     crime      = caps$crime,
                     snap       = caps$snap,
                     park       = caps$park)
      eligible_vec <- c(broadband  = elig$broadband,
                        healthcare = elig$healthcare,
                        crime      = elig$crime,
                        snap       = elig$snap,
                        park       = elig$park)

      eff <- data.frame(
        intervention = names(coefs),
        coef         = coefs,
        cost_per_pt  = base_cost * pm,
        max_improve  = max_imp,
        eligible     = eligible_vec
      ) |>
        filter(eligible == TRUE) |>
        mutate(
          efficiency       = coef / cost_per_pt,
          max_stress_reduc = coef * max_improve
        ) |>
        arrange(desc(efficiency))

      target           <- input$target
      max_contribution <- target * 0.40
      remaining        <- target
      total_cost       <- 0
      plan             <- data.frame()

      for (i in seq_len(nrow(eff))) {
        if (remaining <= 0) break
        row        <- eff[i, ]
        use_reduc  <- min(remaining, row$max_stress_reduc, max_contribution)
        pts_needed <- use_reduc / row$coef
        cost       <- pts_needed * row$cost_per_pt
        plan <- rbind(plan, data.frame(
          Intervention     = row$intervention,
          Improve.by       = round(pts_needed, 1),
          Stress.reduced   = round(use_reduc, 2),
          Cost             = format(round(cost), big.mark = ",")
        ))
        remaining  <- remaining - use_reduc
        total_cost <- total_cost + cost
      }

      list(plan = plan, total_cost = total_cost)
    })

    output$optimizer_table <- renderTable({ optimizer_plan()$plan })

    output$optimizer_summary <- renderText({
      s         <- selected_school()
      result    <- optimizer_plan()
      new_score <- as.numeric(s$composite) - input$target
      paste0(
        "Total cost:      $", format(round(result$total_cost), big.mark=","), "\n",
        "Original score:   ", round(as.numeric(s$composite), 1), "\n",
        "New score:        ", round(new_score, 1), "\n",
        "Pop. multiplier:  ", round(school_meta()$pop_multiplier, 2), "x"
      )
    })

    # Explanation paragraph
    output$explanation_text <- renderUI({
      s    <- selected_school()
      meta <- school_meta()
      caps <- meta$caps
      elig <- meta$eligible

      skipped <- c()
      if (!elig$park)
        skipped <- c(skipped, paste0("park access (already at ",
                     round(as.numeric(s$park_access)), ")"))
      if (!elig$broadband)
        skipped <- c(skipped, paste0("broadband (already at ",
                     round(as.numeric(s$broadband)), ")"))
      if (!elig$snap)
        skipped <- c(skipped, paste0("SNAP (poverty rate ",
                     round(as.numeric(s$poverty)),
                     "% is below the 30% eligibility threshold)"))

      skipped_text <- if (length(skipped) > 0) {
        paste0("Note: ", paste(skipped, collapse = " and "),
               " are not recommended for this school — the gap is too small ",
               "to justify investment. You can still enter values below, ",
               "but they will be capped and costs may not reflect realistic returns.")
      } else {
        "All interventions are eligible for this school."
      }

      tags$div(
        tags$p(paste0(
          "Each input below is capped at the maximum realistic improvement for ",
          input$school_sel, ". Broadband can improve by at most ",
          round(caps$broadband), " points, and crime can be reduced by at most ",
          round(caps$crime), " points. Costs are adjusted by a ",
          round(meta$pop_multiplier, 2), "x population multiplier based on ",
          format(round(as.numeric(s$population), -3), big.mark=","),
          " residents in this county."
        )),
        tags$p(skipped_text, style = "color: #888; font-style: italic;")
      )
    })

    # Cap warning labels
    make_cap_text <- function(val_reactive, cap_name, elig_name) {
      renderText({
        meta <- school_meta()
        cap  <- meta$caps[[cap_name]]
        elig <- meta$eligible[[elig_name]]
        val  <- as.numeric(val_reactive())
        if (!elig) {
          paste0("Max: ", round(cap), " pts (not recommended — see note above)")
        } else if (!is.na(val) && val > cap) {
          paste0("⚠ Capped at ", round(cap), " pts max")
        } else {
          paste0("Max: ", round(cap), " pts")
        }
      })
    }

    output$cap_broadband  <- make_cap_text(reactive(input$s_broadband),  "broadband",  "broadband")
    output$cap_healthcare <- make_cap_text(reactive(input$s_healthcare), "healthcare", "healthcare")
    output$cap_crime      <- make_cap_text(reactive(input$s_crime),      "crime",      "crime")
    output$cap_snap       <- make_cap_text(reactive(input$s_snap),       "snap",       "snap")
    output$cap_park       <- make_cap_text(reactive(input$s_park),       "park",       "park")

    # Manual calculator
    manual_result <- reactive({
      pm      <- school_meta()$pop_multiplier
      caps    <- school_meta()$caps
      K_shiny <- 100 / (63 - 9)

      b  <- min(max(0, input$s_broadband),  caps$broadband)
      h  <- min(max(0, input$s_healthcare), caps$healthcare)
      cr <- min(max(0, input$s_crime),      caps$crime)
      sn <- min(max(0, input$s_snap),       caps$snap)
      pk <- min(max(0, input$s_park),       caps$park)

      data.frame(
        Intervention   = c("Broadband","Healthcare","Crime","SNAP","Park access"),
        Points         = c(b, h, cr, sn, pk),
        Stress.Reduced = round(c(b*(0.05*K_shiny), h*(0.04*K_shiny), cr*(0.10*K_shiny), sn*(0.04*K_shiny), pk*((1/15)*K_shiny)), 2),
        Cost           = format(round(c(
          b*120000*pm, h*320000*pm, cr*90000*pm, sn*700000*pm, pk*400000*pm
        )), big.mark = ",")
      ) |>
        filter(Points > 0)
    })

    output$manual_table <- renderTable({ manual_result() })

    output$manual_summary <- renderText({
      s    <- selected_school()
      pm   <- school_meta()$pop_multiplier
      caps <- school_meta()$caps

      b  <- min(max(0, input$s_broadband),  caps$broadband)
      h  <- min(max(0, input$s_healthcare), caps$healthcare)
      cr <- min(max(0, input$s_crime),      caps$crime)
      sn <- min(max(0, input$s_snap),       caps$snap)
      pk <- min(max(0, input$s_park),       caps$park)

      K_shiny       <- 100 / (63 - 9)
      stress_change <- b*(0.05*K_shiny) + h*(0.04*K_shiny) + cr*(0.10*K_shiny) + sn*(0.04*K_shiny) + pk*((1/15)*K_shiny)
      total_cost    <- (b*120000 + h*320000 + cr*90000 + sn*700000 + pk*400000) * pm
      new_score     <- as.numeric(s$composite) - stress_change

      paste0(
        "Total stress reduction:  ", round(stress_change, 1), " points\n",
        "New stress score:        ", round(new_score, 1), "\n",
        "Total estimated cost:    $", format(round(total_cost), big.mark=",")
      )
    })
  },

  options = list(height = 1000)
)
```
